nodes.name: claude-code.mdx
nodes.summary: Setup guide for using Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on the Mintlify docs project, including a ready-to-use `CLAUDE.md` template that encodes the working relationship, project context (MDX + docs.json), writing standards, frontmatter requirements, and git workflow rules.

nodes.name: cursor.mdx
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Cursor setup guide built around a ~400-line `.cursor/rules.md` project template covering technical writing principles, a full Mintlify component reference (callouts, code groups, steps, tabs, param/response fields, expandables, frames, tooltips, updates), required page structure, and content quality and accessibility standards.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a four-backtick fence to embed a markdown template that itself contains triple-backtick code blocks, a common MDX nesting technique for prompt/rule documents.

nodes.name: windsurf.mdx
nodes.summary: Windsurf setup guide providing a `.windsurf/rules.md` workspace template that teaches the Cascade assistant the docs project context (Mintlify, MDX, docs.json), writing standards, Mintlify component conventions, and API documentation requirements.
